### Added
- **A `call_tool` result names the tool it ran.** The envelope has a new last field, `tool`: `name` (the tool asked for), and for a tool an MCP server serves, `server` (the MCPServer the aggregator dispatched it to) and `serverTool` (the server's own name for it). The same object is the `call_tool` result's `_meta` under `muster.giantswarm.io/tool`. A consumer that attributes a result (shows "ran list_pods on kubernetes") no longer has to remember each call's arguments by call ID. The agent client puts it into the unwrapped result's `_meta`, read with `metatools.DispatchedToolFromMeta`. The wrapped result's envelope bytes are unchanged before the new field. ([#982](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/982))
